CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents; A is absent.

COD.rationale: C and D are explicit but O is not explicitly bound to the same content/attribute/time (organization statement is general), so the triple is not fully co‑bound.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition tied to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-identifying expressions list identified items (positions) and attributes (red/blue) with current timestamps.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata are provided separately from the content position listings, distinguishing content identity from source/status.

O.rationale: A general statement describes how the grid is presented (row/column orientation); however this organization statement is not tied to a specific content referent listed elsewhere.
